summary: The 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup was the 17th edition of FIFA's biennial men's under-17 national team football tournament, organized by FIFA and held in India from 6 to 28 October 2017. India had been awarded hosting rights on 5 December 2013. It was India's first time hosting a FIFA tournament and the first Asian-hosted U-17 World Cup since 2013, and it set an attendance record of 1,347,133 that surpassed China's 1985 edition.
one_line: The 17th FIFA U-17 World Cup, held in India in October 2017, set a new attendance record.
key_facts: The 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup was the 17th FIFA U-17 World Cup.
The FIFA U-17 World Cup is a biennial international football tournament contested by men's under-17 national teams.
The tournament was organized by FIFA.
The 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup took place in India between 6 and 28 October 2017.
India was awarded the hosting rights for the tournament on 5 December 2013.
The 2017 tournament marked the first time India hosted a FIFA tournament.
The 2017 tournament was the first Asian-hosted U-17 World Cup since 2013.
The attendance for the 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup was a record 1,347,133.
The record attendance of 1,347,133 surpassed the 1985 edition held in China, which had an attendance of 1,230,976.
